data.one_liner: Widget to collect annotated screenshots and text feedback from users
data.what_it_does: The package provides a `BetterFeedback` widget that wraps your app and exposes a controller to show a feedback panel. Users can annotate a screenshot of the current screen and add text, then submit the feedback.
use_when: You need a quick way to collect user feedback within the app
You want to support annotated screenshots and text feedback
You need a web‑friendly solution that works with CanvasKit
avoid_when: You require extensive customization of the feedback UI beyond the provided options
You need a built‑in backend integration (you’ll need to use plugins or custom code)
strengths: Easy to integrate – just wrap the app and call the controller
Supports multiple languages and dark mode
Plugins available for GitLab, Sentry, etc.
weaknesses: Limited customization of the feedback UI
No built‑in backend upload – requires plugins or custom code
data.setup_notes: Add `feedback: ^3.2.0` to pubspec, wrap your app in `BetterFeedback`, then call `BetterFeedback.of(context).show(...)`
